text:
Alex: Heads-up — we saw a few requests routed to eu-west even though us-west p50 is ~20ms better. Looks like tiered routing isn't factoring customer tier + model variant penalty. Anyone seen this? :thinking:
Maya: I think this comes from the current scoring function — we only use region latency + health. No tier weights. We should add a tier multiplier and variant_penalty in the policy.
Jorge: Agreed. Proposal: factor = latency_ms * tier_multiplier + region_probe_penalty_ms + variant_penalty_ms; pick lowest factor. Also respect soft affinity and reserved capacity checks.
Maya: ```json
{
  "policy": "latency_priority",
  "tiers": {"enterprise": 0.5, "standard": 1.0, "starter": 1.5},
  "region_probe_penalty_ms": {"eu-west": 10, "us-east": 0, "ap-south": 40},
  "variant_penalties": {"quant-8bit": 12, "float16": 0},
  "soft_affinity_window_ms": 30
}
```
Sam: Nice. Add `soft_affinity` flag: prefer home-region but allow fallback if score diff > X. Also need to consult per-region quota headroom — don't route if reserved quota < estimated_tokens.
Priya: On quotas: routing needs to consult per-customer reserved capacity and global burst budget. If we route across regions we must decrement token budget from the customer's global quota, not region-only buckets; otherwise billing and limits will be inconsistent.
Alex: UX ask: Console should show a "routing preview" for a customer — simulate 1k requests and show percent to each region + chosen variants and reasons (latency vs quota vs health). That will help SEs and SREs validate policies.
Maya: Telemetry plan: emit per-request tags: chosen_region, chosen_variant, heuristic_score, probe_latency_ms, fallback_reason. Make them searchable in traces and aggregated in the metrics pipeline.
Jorge: Edge-case: quantized variants sometimes have worse latency on older kernels despite lower memory. We need a runtime-specific penalty override: `variant_penalty_ms[runtime][variant]`.
Sam: For rollouts: support `canary_region` + `canary_pct` and an automatic ramp if success_rate > threshold. Also add a manual override in the Console for emergency pinning.
Priya: Also ensure logs include token_estimate and quota_snapshot so quota checks are auditable for customer support.
Alex: I'll draft an RFC with the scoring formula, sample config, and console mockups. Can someone own telemetry (dashboard + alerts)?
Maya: I'll own dashboards and create an alert: `region_fallback_rate > 5%` over 1h for any high-tier customer. :+1:
deploy-bot: test-route-checker finished: probe us-west 12ms, eu-west 35ms, ap-south 89ms — all healthy.
Alex: Thanks, team — RFC incoming. Closing thread for now.
